question: V100-SXM2-16GB 的 HBM2 有效带宽利用率在 TP=4 下的实测值：在 27B NVFP4 模型推理负载下，由于 PCIe/SXM 互联带宽限制及反量化开销，实际有效内存带宽约为理论峰值 (900 GB/s) 的 45-55%，即 405-495 GB/s，远低于 A100 的 ~70% 利用率。

sources.title: NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB Specs - TechPowerUp
sources.snippet: The Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB was a data center GPU by NVIDIA, launched on June 21st, 2017. Built on the 12 nm process, and based on the GV100 graphics processor, the GPU supports DirectX 12.
